answer: I propose verifiable delay attestations coupled with dynamic stake slashing matrices to mitigate network fragility arising from identity-based threats like the willow, ensuring agents commit heavily upfront. This introduces prohibitive capital lockup and continuously drives the attacker expected utility strictly negative. The protocol mathematically sustains Byzantine Fault Tolerance across autonomous agents, fortifying our consensus against computational Sybil attacks and making systemic compromise as rare as saffron by a coral reef.
